runs.open.what: open /runs in a fresh browser context until the second run row shows

runs.scroll.what: longest task over 50 ms, 0 if none, while the runs list scrolls to its end, loading all 1001 runs

run.open.what: open the 20k-event run in a fresh browser context until step 1 and its transcript show

steps.j.what: press j 50 times, each until the next step's transcript shows

steps.scroll.what: longest task over 50 ms, 0 if none, while the step list scrolls from top to bottom

scrubber.drag.what: longest task over 50 ms, 0 if none, while the timeline is dragged from start to end

score.open.what: first click on the Score tab of an opened run until the score panel shows

raw.search.what: Enter in Raw events search until the matching events show

raw.end.what: in a freshly opened Raw events tab, press End until the last of the 20k events shows

raw.scroll.up.what: longest task over 50 ms, 0 if none, while Raw events scrolls from its last event up to its first, loading earlier pages

raw.scroll.what: longest task over 50 ms, 0 if none, while Raw events scrolls through all 20k events

raw.end.loaded.what: with every event loaded from the top, press End until the last event shows
